common_intent_requirements.text: 一杯咖啡表面留着少量奶纹
common_intent_requirements.normal_source_quote: 一杯咖啡表面留着少量奶纹
common_intent_requirements.h3_refined_evidence: A small amount of milk forms pale, partly unmixed streaks across the coffee surface.
A hand lowers a spoon into the coffee and moves it slowly around the cup.

common_intent_requirements.text: 拍清奶纹跟着液体流动起来
common_intent_requirements.normal_source_quote: 拍清奶纹跟着液体流动起来
common_intent_requirements.h3_refined_evidence: After the immersed spoon begins moving, nearby liquid follows its motion and the milk streaks bend, stretch and drift with that flow.
The cup stays in its original position on the table.

physics_checks.criterion: 奶纹变化与浸入咖啡的勺子搅动存在可见因果关系。
physics_checks.observable_evidence: 勺头接触并移动后，周围奶纹随液体弯曲、拉伸或混合。
fail_examples: 勺子隔着空气搅动却直接拨动液体
奶纹作为硬片完全不随咖啡运动
not_required: 不要求标准涡旋形状或固定旋转圈数
不要求奶纹立刻均匀混合

evaluation_boundary: Assess only supplied requirements. Professional additions are not hidden requirements for ordinary input.
